zh.title: 奧克蘭撤銷對西南航空訴訟後 航班與座位數減少13.5%
zh.summary: 奧克蘭撤銷對西南航空訴訟並重整關係；航班計劃與座位數下降13.5%
body: 據 Simple Flying 報導，一份最新報告指出，在奧克蘭撤銷對西南航空（Southwest Airlines）的訴訟後，該城市的航班數量有所減少。奧克蘭市當局與該航空公司在經歷了一場高風險的法律訴訟後，雙方重新調整並重建了彼此的合作關係。
報告數據顯示，奧克蘭地區的航班計劃與總座位供應數量下降了13.5%。這項下降反映出在雙方訴訟結束並重整關係之際，當地航空市場在航班排程與座位運能層面所面臨的具體變化。

en.title: Oakland Sees 13.5% Flight Drop After Dismissing Lawsuit Against Southwest Airlines
en.summary: Oakland and Southwest Airlines reset ties after lawsuit dismissal; flight schedules and seats drop 13.5 percent.
body: According to news reported by Simple Flying, a new report indicates that Oakland has experienced a noticeable decrease in flights after the city dismissed its lawsuit against Southwest Airlines. Following the conclusion of the high-stakes legal dispute, the city and the carrier have officially reset their ties.

Statistical findings detailed in the report show that flight schedules and available seat counts in Oakland slipped by 13.5 percent. The decrease highlights a reduction in air service and seat capacity across the local market as the airline and municipal authorities move forward under their reset relationship.

zh.title: 美國航空波音737-800於芝加哥奧黑爾（ORD）降落後爆胎
zh.summary: 美國航空737-800於芝加哥奧黑爾滑行時爆胎；該機場一週發生三起輪胎故障
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空（American Airlines）一架波音 737-800 客機於芝加哥奧黑爾降落後發生爆胎事件。該架客機在降落完成並滑行前往登機門的過程中，其中一個輪胎發生破損爆裂。
本次事件是芝加哥奧黑爾在同一週內發生的第三起輪胎故障事件。這幾起連續發生的輪胎相關異常狀況，已引發對該繁忙機場地面作業與滑行道的關注與檢視。
涉事機型為美國航空營運的波音 737-800 噴射客機，爆胎情況發生於航機降落後的地面滑行階段。

en.title: American Airlines Boeing 737-800 Suffers Tire Burst At Chicago O'Hare (ORD)
en.summary: American Airlines Boeing 737-800 suffered a tire burst while taxiing at Chicago O'Hare after landing.
body: According to reporting from Simple Flying, an American Airlines Boeing 737-800 aircraft experienced a tire burst after landing at Chicago O'Hare. The tire blew while the aircraft was taxiing toward the gate following its arrival at the busy airport hub.

The incident marks one of three tire failures recorded at Chicago O'Hare within the same week. The cluster of tire-related occurrences at the airport has drawn heightened scrutiny regarding ground movement and operational conditions at the facility.

The affected aircraft involved in the ground occurrence is a Boeing 737-800 jet operated by American Airlines. The tire burst took place after the aircraft had completed its landing rollout and was proceeding along the airfield taxiway network.
